summary: Full end-to-end backend + frontend testing of Order Desk. 12/12 pytest backend tests passed (files, orders, stage transitions with LR gating, payments, customers, payments overview, archive). Frontend Playwright covered: create order (2 items) → dashboard card verification → phone autofill → order detail stage checks (Ordered/Partially Ordered) → LR-gated dispatch (modal blocks without upload, LR link shown after) → progression to Payment Pending → full payment → Completed with balance 0 → Customers tab (lifetime value + customer visible) → Payments tab (Payments Archive shows fully-paid order, Pending Collections empty) → Archive tab loads (empty as expected since 3-day rule not elapsed). All data-testid selectors resolved. No blocker or minor bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stage endpoint: when dispatched is unchecked (done=false), lr_document_id is cleared. Consider preserving history for audit.
compute_derived: 'Confirmed' label is used when no stage progressed; consider aligning to 'Ordered' since order was placed. Minor UX naming choice, not a bug.
customers grouping keys on phone; empty phone falls back to name which could collide. Acceptable given phone is required at creation.

OrderDetail.jsx StageCheck: click while busy is disabled via `busy` flag but multiple sequential clicks across items rely on individual state; observed briefly in test where checkbox showed spinner. Not a defect.
seed_data_creation: Created one order for Ravi Sharma / 9877712345 / Sharma Traders with 2 items, total 50000, advance 10000; progressed to Completed with full payment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Test data uses TEST_ prefix for pytest-created orders and cleans up on module teardown. UI-created seed order 'Ravi Sharma' with phone 9877712345 remains for phone-autofill re-tests.
